info.title: My SmartHealth app API (Mediqzy)
info.description:
The contract the My SmartHealth mobile app and partners build against.

Authentication is a bearer JWT from sign-in. Every endpoint acts only for the caller; none takes a user, member or corporate id that would let one caller act for another.

Errors carry `success: false` and a `message`; integration and SmartCRM errors add a stable `code` to branch on.

Scope: /api/employee (corporate employee, policy wallet, SmartCRM link and enrolment), /api/addresses lookup, the social sign-in hand-off, and admin integration status. Other endpoints are not yet part of the contract.

post.summary: Redeem the one-time code from a Google/Facebook mobile sign-in for the tokens
post.description:
Mobile flow: open /api/auth/google (or /facebook) with mobile_redirect_uri=mysmarthealth://oauth-callback, your own random `state`, and code_challenge = BASE64URL(SHA256(code_verifier)) with code_challenge_method=S256.

The app is called back with `code` and your `state` (check it matches) — never a token. Post the code with the original code_verifier here within 60 seconds. A code works once; a wrong verifier consumes it.

400.description: Expired, already used, or the verifier does not match.

503.description: Hand-off storage unavailable; sign in again.

IntegrationError.description: A third-party API Mediqzy depends on is unavailable, switched off, not configured or answered badly. `retryable` says whether trying again later can help.

type.description: Category, e.g. opd, pharmacy, dental, hospitalization, maternity.

documents.description: The member's own uploaded reports, as report:<id>.

memberId.description: "self" or the id of one of the member's own family members.

Enrolment.description: How and whether the member can enrol on this policy (ADR-001 phase 1).

status.description: live_check: SmartCRM owns the window; ask GET /api/employee/enrolment/window.

source.description: smartcrm = projected from SmartCRM, the system of record.

missing.description: Terms the employer never supplied — shown as missing, never defaulted.

InsuranceLinkState.description: Whether this member's insurance is linked to SmartCRM (ADR-001).

policiesUnavailable.description: Set when the policy wallet could not be read; the rest of the response still stands.

Forbidden.description: The caller's account type may not use this endpoint.

NotFound.description: Not found, or not the caller's.

IntegrationUnavailable.description: A third-party API this endpoint depends on is unavailable. See `retryable`.

SmartCrmRefusal.description: Refused by the SmartCRM integration (not linked, switched off, window closed, …). Branch on `code`.
